query:
-- Trouver les IDs des derniers pointages à 22h pour chaque résident
UPDATE residents r
SET missedCheckoutAttendanceId = (
  SELECT a.id 
  FROM attendances a 
  WHERE a.residentId = r.id 
  AND TIME(a.checkOutTime) = '22:00:00'
  ORDER BY a.checkInTime DESC 
  LIMIT 1
)
WHERE r.hasMissedCheckout = true 
AND r.missedCheckoutAttendanceId IS NULL
AND (r.firstName = 'enka' OR r.firstName = 'Nicolas');
